chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amir narrated to me from al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Abi Dawud al-Mustariq, from some of our companions, from Muthanna al-Hannat, from Abi al-Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him say: Whoever goes to al-Husayn (peace be upon him) knowing his right, all of his sins, past and future, will be forgiven.

key_terms.عَارِفاً بِحَقِّهِ: Knowing his right (spiritual and religious status)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing Ziyarah to Imam Husayn with knowledge of his rights?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Kazim (peace be upon him) states that performing Ziyarah (visitation) to Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him) with knowledge of his rights leads to the forgiveness of all sins, both past and future. It emphasizes the spiritual merit and intercessory power associated with the Ahl al-Bayt. In Shia scholarship, 'knowing his rights' (ma'rifat huquqihi) is considered a prerequisite for the validity of the visitation, linking the physical act to deep theological recognition of Husayn's role as the proof of God.
